topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I just found out the surprise party for me has been called off. It’s a bit of a letdown, but things happen. I appreciate the effort everyone put into planning it. It’s the thought that counts, and I know they wanted to do something special. I’ll catch up with everyone soon, maybe find a new way to celebrate. Life is full of surprises, good and not so good, but it’s all part of the journey.
